Its relatively large distance also makes it slightly smaller than average.

A highly experienced observer might conceivably detect it with exceptional transparency, precise pointing, and the Sun safely blocked by a building, but an ordinary observer using unaided vision would be **very unlikely to spot it**, even knowing roughly where to look.
